newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber sharply higher-limit up in late trade.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber sharply higher-limit up in late trade.

text.p: CME lumber futures were sharply higher to up the $10.00-per-thousand-board-feet limit in late trade, boosted by fund short covering, floor sources said.
Dealers said early buying linked to a strengthening cash market helped prompt funds to cover short positions.
At 1306 CDT September lumber was bid the $10.00 limit up at $381.00 with other months up $7.90 to $4.90.
Random Lengths on Friday quoted cash spruce at $372 per tbf, up $10 from midweek and $18 above last Friday's level.
